senses.gloss:
कीदृक्ष कीदृक्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. कि or किद्
and दृक्ष, rt. दृश्, see ईदृक्ष), of what kind?
of what sort? of what description? of what qualities?
who or what like?

कीदृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. ङ्, of what kind? of what sort?
&c., who or what like? यादृक्-कीदृक्-च, of what-
soever kind or sort.
—कीदृग्-व्यापारवत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, of what profession or vocation?

कीदृश, अस्, ई, अम्, of what kind? what like?
